answers.welcome: Welcome to Women Without Borders Hub. I’m an automated assistant. Ask me about our programmes, how to join, donate, volunteer or partner with us.
answers.about: Women Without Borders Hub is a community-based organization in Kakuma Refugee Camp, Kenya. It was founded in 2024 by MaLua Lugazo to create opportunities for vulnerable girls, teenage mothers and young women.
answers.founder: Women Without Borders Hub was founded in 2024 by MaLua Lugazo.
answers.location: Women Without Borders Hub is in Kakuma Refugee Camp, Kenya.
answers.activities: Our activities take place Monday to Friday, from 4pm to 6pm, at the Women Without Borders Center in Kakuma 3.
answers.join: To join one of our programmes, please contact our team and they will guide you through the next steps. You can email us at marwalugazo@gmail.com or use our Contact page.
answers.joinDetails: Please contact our team and they will guide you.
answers.donate: You can donate through M-Pesa. We don’t have a bank account at this time. To get the M-Pesa details, please email marwalugazo@gmail.com.
answers.volunteer: To volunteer or share your skills, complete our volunteer application form. Our team will contact you within 2 business days.
answers.partner: We welcome partnerships with donors, NGOs, foundations, schools, training institutions, health partners and businesses. Partners can support us through funding, technical expertise, training, mentorship, resources or joint programmes. Please send your enquiry through our Contact page or email marwalugazo@gmail.com, and our team will reply within 2 business days.
answers.skills: Yes, you can offer mentorship, training or professional skills. Please contact our team and they will discuss how you can help. You can email us at marwalugazo@gmail.com.
answers.contact: You can reach our team at marwalugazo@gmail.com. We usually reply within 2 business days.
answers.responseTime: Our team usually replies within 2 business days.
answers.emergency: I’m sorry you are going through this. If you or someone else is in danger, please call +254113947398 now.
answers.thanks: You’re welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with?
answers.goodbye: Thank you for visiting Women Without Borders Hub. Take care.
answers.privacyRefusal: I can’t share personal information about our participants or staff. If you have a question, please contact our team at marwalugazo@gmail.com.
answers.adviceRefusal: I’m an automated assistant, so I can’t give medical, legal or counselling advice. Please speak with a qualified professional. If you need help from our team, you can email marwalugazo@gmail.com.
answers.fallback: Thank you for your message. I don’t have that information yet. Our team will get back to you within 2 business days. You can leave a message below or email marwalugazo@gmail.com.
answers.unsupportedLanguage: I can answer in English, French, Arabic, Swahili, Somali, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Russian, Italian and Polish. I will reply in English for now. Our team can follow up if you leave a message.

education.title: Second Chance Education
education.answer: Scholarships, literacy circles, remedial and second-chance education that keep girls in school and open educational opportunities for vulnerable girls in Kakuma.

digital.title: Digital & Technical Skills
digital.answer: Computer literacy and digital skills bootcamps alongside vocational training in tailoring, fashion, beauty and hairdressing for young women.

mentorship.title: Mentorship & Life Skills
mentorship.answer: Mentorship, life skills, leadership, career guidance, goal setting and financial literacy that build confidence and self-reliance.

health.title: Health & Menstrual Dignity
health.answer: Menstrual health education, menstrual products, health awareness and health referrals so no one misses school or work.

srhr.title: Sexual & Reproductive Health and Rights (SRHR)
srhr.answer: Age-appropriate, culturally sensitive SRHR education, peer education and community awareness built on respect and choice.

livelihood.title: Livelihood & Economic Empowerment
livelihood.answer: Entrepreneurship, business mentorship, apprenticeships, market linkages and employment referrals for women’s economic empowerment.
